title: No payment setup and cancellation does not work.
body:
I want to cancel or delete my card information, but the system is set up in such a way that I cannot do so.
 Even if I cancel, the card is still attempted. Even if you wanted to delete it completely, it is set up so that you cannot delete it from your account management.
 This is a completely convincing case.

title: Ok but
body:
Before we start to use any application we want trial period. In situation with this app I even don’t know for what im going to pay. Even for one week only. 
There is not a big deal but I wanna know what is inside. 
Finally II get subscription a finished few quizzes. 
I’m honestly answered an all question and what: you’re doing very well/ completely ok etc.
Application just ignored some of important moments in the answers and referred that all is well. 
Well. I’m cancelling my sub. 
You are guys want money but there is all the same things that we have for free in open internet. Try better. And make a trial period for people.
